head: Cole plays his 1,000th game, but the Blackhawks lose
paras: Connor Bedard opened the scoring for the Blackhawks early in the first, but they didn’t score again. Jake Evans made it 1-1 for Montréal late in the period, and he struck again shorthanded early in the second to put the Canadiens ahead 2-1. The Blackhawks went just over 18 minutes without a shot on goal, from midway through the second to midway through the third, while the Habs put ten on net. Kaiden Guhle stretched the lead to 3-1 late in the second, and Mike Matheson added an empty-net goal with less than three minutes left to make it 4-1. Evans added an assist for a three-point night.
The chances were closer than the score. Jacob Fowler made 20 saves for the Canadiens, and Spencer Knight stopped 24 of 27 at the other end.

Neither power play scored: the Canadiens killed all five Blackhawks power plays, and the Blackhawks killed all three of Montréal’s. The Canadiens moved to 5-3-2 and climbed to fifth in the Atlantic, while the Blackhawks dropped to 3-7-0, still last in the Central.

items.text: Connor Bedard has a point in all six of his games against Montréal since 2023-24.
The Blackhawks’ Ian Cole played his 1,000th NHL game.
Mike Matheson scored his first goal of the season, his first since Mar 31 (twelve games played since).
